title: the void operator starts a Promise and abandons it
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Promise Semantics': 'Authored `.sm` code MUST consume Promise instances only through `await`.' docs/DECISIONS.md (Locked, Concurrency): every started Promise MUST be consumed. `void work()` is the canonical fire-and-forget spelling and is exactly what the rule forbids. REVIEW-fable-1.md F1 measured this exact program COMPILING, EMITTING AND RUNNING on the Go fork with zero diagnostics: the checked value was discarded at runtime, which is the loss the rule exists to prevent. The fork's unbound must-consume rule fired only when an expression statement's own expression typed as Result or Promise, so every container and operator position was invisible to it.
